cost: Two complete decompressions O(2B) plus hashing/strings; O(A+S) retained analysis/synthesis bytes. Empty vocab still reads twice; no byte cap.
description: Two-pass VESUM loading: vocabulary-limited analyses and full selected-paradigm synthesis.
forward: Pass1 tracks lemma/tags/government from bz2 lines, normalizes forms and retains vocab matches. Keys lemma|POS#xp use merged first xp marker; verb/prep inherit lemma government. Pass2 rescans all forms of selected lemma keys into synthesis.
inverse: norm preimage includes case, invisible/stress, apostrophe variants. Morph admits arbitrary unselected entries, comments/ignored tags; lemma_of discards POS/xp; synth offers multiple compatible surface forms.
limitations: No real VESUM, corpus, changed-between-passes or streaming-fault tests.
Partial lexical AST; no semantic proof or useful executable percentage surrogate.
state: Unchanged file across passes: retained analyses select lemma paradigms; unrequested forms may enter synth but not forms. Vectors retain dictionary order/duplicates. norm is lossy lowercase/invisible/apostrophe projection.
